sloka: ततः क्रुद्धस्य वदनाद्यमस्य समजायत ।ज्वालामाली सनिःश्वासः सधूमः कोपपावकः ।। ७.२२.२२ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ kruddhasya vadanādyamasya samajāyata ।jvālāmālī saniḥśvāsaḥ sadhūmaḥ kopapāvakaḥ ।। 7.22.22 ॥

translations.english: Rāvaṇa wounded Death with four sharp arrows, afflicted the charioteer with seven, and quickly struck Yama in his vital spots with a hundred thousand arrows.
